name: Leyesaurus
sum: Leyesaurus is a massospondylid sauropodomorph from the Early Jurassic Quebrada del Barro Formation of San Juan Province, Argentina, known from a nearly complete skull.
wsnote: Estimate quoted by the cited Wikipedia revision; the skull is 18 cm long.
holotype: PVSJ 706, a nearly complete skull with articulated mandible and some postcranial remains (vertebral column, shoulder and pelvic girdles, hindlimb), from the uppermost Quebrada del Barro Formation.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Apaldetti et al. 2011
